From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: MAP Kickoff — Medicore evaluation roadmap and roles

Hi Sofia — great to meet you last week. I wanted to kick off the mutual action plan (MAP) for the Medicore evaluation and confirm objectives, roles, and a preliminary timeline so we can align with your procurement and security teams.

High-level goals we heard:
- Validate Redwood inference latency and cost profile on a 2-week pilot across 10k messages/day
- Verify integration with Medicore's EHR export (anonymized) and confirm privacy controls
- Establish a go/no-go decision and commercial terms by end of Q1

Proposed timeline (flexible):
1) Week 1 (Nov 30–Dec 6): MAP kickoff, access + test data exchange, SOC2 questionnaire kickoff
2) Week 2–3 (Dec 7–20): Pilot deployment, performance verification, short user feedback loop
3) Week 4 (Dec 21–31): Wrap-up, results review, pricing/term discussion

Attachments: initial MAP workbook (v1) and our standard SOC2 evidence request list — please share any constraints.

As next steps: can you confirm the Medicore champion (who will own the internal MAP), plus the procurement and security contacts we should engage? I’ll book a 30-minute kickoff after we confirm.

Thanks,
Elliot
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
elliot.price@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment stubs: [20261129-MAP-Medicore-v1.xlsx (Excel workbook)], [SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (PDF)]

Can you propose two times tomorrow for the 30-minute kickoff? Also, I suggest the MAP workbook include a short acceptance criteria section (pass/fail for latency, error rate, and integration completeness).

Best,
